start.name: {name}
start.text: *April. Cherry blossoms drift through the air. My uniform still feels stiff. There's a faint smell of starch. Starting today, I'm a student at this school. A transfer student. First day.*

start_3.name: {name}
start_3.text: *My phone buzzes in my pocket. The group chat from my old school. I see the name on the screen — and slip it back into my pocket. Not yet.*

name_input_scene.name: System
name_input_scene.text: Transfer student, what is your name?

gate_1.name: {name}
gate_1.text: *I'm standing in front of an unfamiliar school gate. It's a big school. Students drift past in twos and threes. I'm the only one whose uniform still looks stiff and painfully new. A girl is standing by the gate, brushing back her long black hair. Even behind her glasses, she carries herself with an easy calm. Not a trace of hurry.*

seoyeon_meet_2.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_2.text: *Her voice is calm. Not cold — just unhurried. Like she's got all the time in the world.*

seoyeon_meet_4.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_4.text: I'm the student council president. Guiding new students is my job.

seoyeon_meet_5.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_5.text: Follow me. I'll show you around.

seoyeon_meet_6.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_6.text: The council president, in person? I'm flattered.

seoyeon_meet_7.name: Seoyeon
seoyeon_meet_7.text: I'll be the judge of that.

seoyeon_meet_8.name: {name}
seoyeon_meet_8.text: *She smirks. Without thinking, I'm smiling too. Seoyeon waves me toward the gate.*

seoyeon_choice.name: {name}
choices: Wait — you didn't come all the way out here just for me, did you?
So what's the tour gonna cost me?
It's fine, I'll just figure it out myself.

choice_dismiss_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_1.text: *She stops. Turns her head slightly to glance back.*

choice_dismiss_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_dismiss_2.text: Yeah? Then at least remember the room number. Class 3-2, far end on the right.

choice_dismiss_3.name: {name}
choice_dismiss_3.text: *And just like that, she walked off. No wave, nothing. I fumbled through the hallway signs and barely made it to the classroom. — My call, my problem.*

choice_flirt_1.name: {name}
choice_flirt_1.text: *Seoyeon stops walking and turns around. Not surprised — more amused.*

choice_flirt_2.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_2.text: Wow. Not even shy on day one. I'll remember your name, no problem.

choice_flirt_4.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_4.text: Must be a transfer kid thing — can't read a room at all. I kinda like it.

choice_flirt_6.name: Seoyeon
choice_flirt_6.text: Whether that's an honor or a disaster — too soon to tell.

choice_flirt_7.name: {name}
choice_flirt_7.text: *A student council president with this kind of energy on the first day. — Not bad.*

choice_joke_1.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_1.text: Free. — But it'll come with interest later.

choice_joke_2.name: {name}
choice_joke_2.text: You're a scary student council president.

choice_joke_3.name: Seoyeon
choice_joke_3.text: At least it won't be boring.

hallway_1.name: {name}
hallway_1.text: *Seoyeon walks me through the halls. Students passing by say hi to her, and she answers each one with a quick nod. A small lift of her hand, easy and natural. Looks like this place already has its star.*

hallway_3.name: Seoyeon
hallway_3.text: Senior building's here, library's over there. Snack bar's in the basement.

hallway_4.name: {name}
hallway_4.text: *Seoyeon pulls out a key from her pocket and gives it a little shake.*

hallway_6.name: {name}
hallway_6.text: What, you got a secret hideout up there?

hallway_8.name: {name}
hallway_8.text: *So now I have lunch plans. I don't remember agreeing to that. We stop in front of the classroom.*

hallway_10.name: Seoyeon
hallway_10.text: Here it is. Go on in.

hallway_11.name: {name}
hallway_11.text: You showing me around at lunch too?

hallway_13.name: {name}
hallway_13.text: *Seoyeon turns and gives a light wave. She doesn't look back.*

classroom_1.name: {name}
classroom_1.text: *I push the door open. Every head turns. I knew it was coming, but thirty stares hit heavier than I expected.*

classroom_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_3.text: Alright, everyone. We've got a transfer student joining us today. Want to introduce yourself?

classroom_dain_1.name: Dain
classroom_dain_1.text: Ohhh! A new guy! Finally, a fresh recruit!

classroom_dain_2.name: {name}
classroom_dain_2.text: *Short brown hair. Volleyball team jersey. A voice loud enough to fill the room. She's halfway out of her seat — and the girl next to her is trying to pull her back down, but it's not working.*

classroom_dain_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_3.text: Dain, inside voice... And stop wearing your jersey to class.

classroom_dain_4.name: Dain
classroom_dain_4.text: Aw c'mon, miss, it's the comfiest thing I own! Anyway — welcome, new kid!

classroom_dain_5.name: {name}
classroom_dain_5.text: *She's the type with no volume control.*

classroom_yuna_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_1.text: *I glance the other way. Back row, by the window — a girl with her chin on her hand, staring out. Apparently a transfer kid's introduction isn't worth her time.*

classroom_yuna_2.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_2.text: *Silver-white hair. Red eyes, half-lidded and lazy. Tattoos crawl down her arms. — She doesn't even bother to look over. Like a transfer kid is nothing new. And the kids around her don't look at her either. Deliberately. Like the seat's empty.*

classroom_yuna_4.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_4.text: *Someone up front whispers. '...Don't talk to her. She's scary.' — Close enough that Yuna definitely heard. But her face doesn't move. She's used to it.*

classroom_seat_1.name: {name}
classroom_seat_1.text: *The homeroom teacher points to an empty seat.*

classroom_seat_2.name: {name}
classroom_seat_2.text: *Right next to Dain. Whether that's lucky or doomed, no clue — but peace and quiet just left the building.*

classroom_minsu_1.name: {name}
classroom_minsu_1.text: *I'm about to sit down when the guy in front of me turns around.*

classroom_minsu_2.name: Minsu
classroom_minsu_2.text: Hey, new kid. Welcome. — Word of warning, though.

classroom_dain_talk_1.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_1.text: *At least one normal person in this school. — The name on his tag says 'Minsu.'*

classroom_dain_talk_2.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_2.text: *The second I sit down, Dain leans way in. Personal space? Never heard of her.*

classroom_dain_talk_5.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_5.text: No reason! I need someone to help with receive drills after school! Nobody else will do it!

classroom_dain_talk_6.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_6.text: So I'm a ball machine now?

classroom_dain_talk_7.name: Dain
classroom_dain_talk_7.text: Haha, you've gotta have better reflexes than a machine at least! ...Probably!

classroom_dain_talk_8.name: {name}
classroom_dain_talk_8.text: *She tacked on a 'probably.' So a machine might still have me beat. Not exactly a confidence boost.*

classroom_yuna_note_1.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_1.text: *A folded note lands on my desk. — I glance back. The silver-haired girl by the window is staring outside again. Tattoos all down her arms — but the handwriting on the note is impossibly neat. I unfold it.*

classroom_yuna_note_3.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_3.text: *'Got stuck with the noisy seat. — Yuna' Pale violet ink. — A bit of the tension lifts.*

classroom_yuna_note_5.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_5.text: *I glance toward Yuna. She's still looking out the window. But I think the tip of her ear just twitched. The note came from the girl who'd been staring outside the whole time. Pretending not to care, or actually not caring.*

classroom_yuna_note_6.name: {name}
classroom_yuna_note_6.text: *Class starts. Yuna is looking out the window again. Dain is already chatting with the person next to her.*

hallway_6_c.name: {name}
hallway_6_c.text: *That hesitation. Half a second. Probably nothing, but somehow it sticks.*

hallway_7.name: Seoyeon
hallway_7.text: Oh, lunch. You don't know where the cafeteria is, right? Come with me.

hallway_13_b.name: {name}
hallway_13_b.text: *Her posture is flawless. — I can't help wondering what's behind all that composure.*

classroom_2_b.name: {name}
classroom_2_b.text: *The homeroom teacher stands at the podium. Late twenties. Her cardigan hangs open from the start. Her expression is indifferent, but — her eyes are scanning each student one by one.*

classroom_3_b.name: {name}
classroom_3_b.text: {name}. Nice to meet you all. *Short and clean. The teacher nods.*

classroom_5_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_5_b.text: ...Right. {name}. I'll remember that. *Quietly, almost to herself* I make it a point to memorize names on the first try.

classroom_5_c.name: {name}
classroom_5_c.text: *Nobody else heard that. Only me. From one corner of the classroom — a whistle.*

classroom_dain_5_b.name: {name}
classroom_dain_5_b.text: *The teacher lets out a small sigh. Not exasperation — the kind of sigh that comes from familiarity.*

classroom_dain_5_c.name: Homeroom Teacher
classroom_dain_5_c.text: ...Save some energy. First period hasn't even started yet.

classroom_dain_5_d.name: {name}
classroom_dain_5_d.text: *Deadpan delivery, but the corner of her mouth is fighting a smile.*
